title: Environment settings
summary: An environment block provides named values to the pipeline. Use it for ordinary configuration, not hard-coded secrets.
introduction: An environment block provides named values to the pipeline. Use it for ordinary configuration, not hard-coded secrets. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An environment block provides named values to the pipeline. Use it for ordinary configuration, not hard-coded secrets.
The setting gives later steps a shared value. This is a declarative pipeline fragment.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose a non-secret test mode setting.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A value written in a Jenkinsfile is visible to people who can read that file.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
